voices.note: the Sages disputing R' Yehuda in the mishna
anonymous redactorial voice: the two unmarked readings of the side clause

props.gloss_en: the mishna: one may not pierce the plug of a barrel -- the words of R' Yehuda
the mishna: and the Sages permit [piercing the plug]
the mishna: and he may not pierce it on its side [what 'it' is, is read differently at 146a.10]
Rav Huna: the dispute is [piercing the plug] from above
Rav Huna: but from the side, all agree it is forbidden
and that is what it teaches: 'he may not pierce it on its side' [the plug, from the side]
Rav Chisda: the dispute is [piercing the plug] from the side
Rav Chisda: but on its top, all agree it is permitted
and what it teaches, 'he may not pierce it on its side' -- there it is the body of the barrel
